text:
Maya Singh: Heads-up — planning to declare Inference Gateway v1 'GA-ready' on Dec 1. This thread to capture final signoffs: SLA numbers, pricing SKUs, monitoring/runbook, oncall rota, and public docs timeline.

Oliver Hart: Proposed SLAs: Hosted Tier-A 99.95% monthly uptime; Dedicated 99.98%. Latency SLOs: embeddings p95 <= 40ms, small-gen p95 <= 120ms. Also add error-rate SLO: 5xx < 0.1% (1h rolling).

Priya Shah: Agreed on SLOs. For fallback behavior we'll document: primary model -> quantized fallback -> regional failover -> customer-configured safe-mode. Will draft decision table.

Ben Torres: Pricing: keep 3 SKUs (dev, standard, enterprise). Standard: steady QPS 150, burst 450 for 30s, then token-based throttling. Dev tokens limited to 5 RPS. Enterprise: committed capacity + SLA. Need final numbers to publish examples.

Maya Singh: Docs ask: public release notes + FAQ + pricing examples. docs-bot can you stage the public pages once we lock numbers?

docs-bot: Staged pages created at https://docs.redwood.com/staging/igw-ga. Waiting on final SLA & pricing props to promote.

Priya Shah: Monitoring/runbook items to wire before GA: sustained p95 breach >5m (runbook step A), error spike >0.5% 5m (step B), GPU util >90% 10m (step C), cache-hit drop >20% 10m (step D). Each alert must include immediate mitigation and PD escalation path.

Oliver Hart: I'll add the alert rules and dashboards. Ops: confirm PagerDuty routing for Enterprise during GA?

ops-bot: Created provisional PD escalation "IGW-GA-enterprise" and calendar stub "IGW GA oncall"; invited Ben, Priya, Oliver. Runbook stub published under /runbooks/igw-ga. Smoke window scheduled Nov 30 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Ben Torres: Sales ask: list of known limitations for GA (no cold-start SLA, regional data residency caveats). We'll need a short blurb for AE playbook. Who owns that?

Maya Singh: Ben own AE playbook blurb. Priya own fallback + runbook. Oliver own SLA doc + alerts. Docs-bot own public pages.

Priya Shah: One open decision: do we advertise cold-start percentiles publicly? Proposal: publish cold-start metrics (p50/p95) in docs but not as SLA for GA.

Oliver Hart: +1 — metrics in docs only. SLA would require multi-week stability which we don't have yet.

Ben Torres: :white_check_mark: AE blurb draft by Tue EOD.

Priya Shah: :white_check_mark: fallback + runbook draft by Wed morning.

Oliver Hart: :white_check_mark: SLA PR + dashboard by Wed EOD.

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: staging pages live; will promote when PRs merge.

Maya Singh: Final checklist recap here (owners):
- SLA numbers and public SLA doc -> Oliver
- Error-rate SLO and fallback decision table -> Priya
- Pricing SKUs + example calcs -> Ben + Docs-bot
- Runbook + PD rota -> Priya + ops-bot
- Monitoring alerts wired to dashboards -> Oliver
- AE playbook limitations blurb -> Ben

Maya Singh: Please react :white_check_mark: once your item is green. If any blockers, call them out now so we can escalate in Thurs pre-GA sync.

Priya Shah: tagging @here — will test failover flows during smoke window and post results.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook review Thurs 09:30 PT. Automated smoketests will post results after Nov 30 window.

Maya Singh: Thanks everyone — will consolidate signoffs after Thurs review.
